args.title: Corvid Packaging Newsletter Summary — Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns handling a major cost center for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs reduced handling costs by roughly 20%, showing centralization as an effective mitigation strategy.
- Reselling returned items quickly (within 10 days) preserved most of the original margin, underscoring the value of speed in the resale pipeline.
